input: # Behaviours this repo depends on from @tabnas/xml, pinned in BOTH runtimes.
# Every row here was a defect or an under-rejection in @tabnas/xml v0.4.1 and
# is fixed in the sibling checkout; they are the difference between the
# GOWORK=off and workspace-on feedvalidator numbers (see AGENTS.md).
# A UTF-8 BOM before the document element is stripped, not lexed as content.
﻿<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>
# XML 1.0 4.1 WFC "Entity Declared": a reference is not an error when the
# declarations could live in an unread external subset. Left verbatim.
<!DOCTYPE feed SYSTEM "x.dtd"><feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><title>a b</title></feed>
# strictNamespaces:false opts out of namespace well-formedness (bare XML 1.0).
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><dc:language>en</dc:language></feed>
# feed installs Xml with strictNamespaces:true, unlike bare @tabnas/xml.
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><dc:language>en</dc:language></feed>
expected: ERROR:element or attribute uses an undeclared namespace prefix

input: # The mismatched-tag message interpolates its operands: it used to read
# "closing tag </$fsrc> does not match opening tag <$openname>".
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><title>x</feed></title>
expected: ERROR:closing tag </feed> does not match opening tag <title>

input: # XML 1.0 [66] admits only a lowercase "&#x"; "&" is not a reference.
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><title>a&b</title></feed>
# A namespace name may not contain white space.
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:a="http://x\ny"/>
expected: ERROR:namespace name cannot contain white space

input: # XML 1.0 2.1: document ::= prolog element Misc* — nothing but Misc may
# follow the document element.
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/><extra/>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>junk
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element
